_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Technical Directive Compliance Reports
summary: The Technical Directive Compliance Reports provide the data required to report the status of compliance with Technical Directives for government-owned equipment in contractor custody.
use_relationship:
The Technical Directive Compliance Reports will be used to obtain the data required to report the status of compliance with Technical Directives.
The contractor reports to the government all technical directive compliances accomplished on government owned equipment in the custody of the contractor and approved by the government for the incorporation in the article(s) of the contract by submitting a technical directive compliance report as soon as possible after completion of actions directed in the technical directive.
This DID contains the format, content, and preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific task requirement as delineated in the contract.
This DID supersedes DI-MGMT-80224C.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Technical Directive Compliance Report (TDCR) shall include the status of all Technical Directive (TD) compliances.

children.title: TDCR Data Elements.
children.content: The TDCR shall contain the following data:

children.title: Type Equipment Code
children.content: Enter a four character code, which identifies the type equipment being modified (example: FA-18E = AMAH).

children.title: BUNO/Serial Number
children.content: Enter six characters which identifies the specific equipment being modified. For Serial Numbers, less than six characters precede with zeroes. For Serial Numbers greater than six characters, use last six characters.

children.title: TD Code
children.content: Enter two digit number corresponding to the TD type (See Figure 1) (example: Airframe Change = 50).

children.title: Basic Number
children.content: Enter a four-digit number identifying a specific TD (example: TD 107 = 0107).

children.title: Interim
children.content: Enter I, if interim TD, otherwise leave blank.

children.title: Revision
children.content: Enter alphabetic character identifying the TD if revision, otherwise leave blank.

children.title: Amendment
children.content: Enter numeric character identifying the TD if amendment, otherwise leave blank.

children.title: TD Part Number
children.content: Enter two digit used to identify the TD, if TD was issued as parts, otherwise leave blank.

children.title: Kit Number
children.content: Enter two characters identifying the kit installed (example: A1). If no kit is required, enter 00.

children.title: Incorporating Activity
children.content: Enter six characters identifying the activity incorporating the TD.

children.title: Incorporation Date
children.content: Enter six digits in the form MMDDYY (example: April, 01 2023 = 040103).

children.title: Work Unit Code
children.content: Enter up to seven alphanumeric characters.

children.title: Comply Status
children.content: Enter C (for current compliance), P (for previous compliance), or D (not applicable).

children.title: Man-hours
children.content: Enter four numeric characters. If less than four characters, precede with zeroes (example: 10 = 0010).

children.title: Maintenance Level
children.content: Enter 5 (Contractor Incorporated) or 6 (Contractor Mod Team). The following data elements are required when reporting a component TD (example: Avionics).

children.title: Component Serial Number
children.content: Enter up to 10 alphanumeric characters identifying the component being modified.

children.title: Inducted CAGE
children.content: Enter 5 characters.

children.title: Inducted Part Number
children.content: Enter up to 15 characters, identifying the inducted part.

children.title: Produced CAGE
children.content: Enter 5 characters, if applicable.

children.title: Produced Part Number
children.content: Enter up to 15 characters, identifying the produced part number, when a TD caused a part number change, if applicable.
